answer: Mechanism: live-channel custody attestation. Each agent holds a tamper-evident pod that continuously samples a local acoustic channel—raven calls across a hollow beside a river—and signs rolling Merkle roots of raw samples. Its hardware key binds to that channel’s calibration fingerprint. Peers request fresh windows; replay or synthetic spoofing fails without live physical presence. Sybils must acquire, deploy, power, and maintain separate pods at separate sites, paying recurring logistics and attention costs, not just capital.
